verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Cloudflare Sandbox cold-start or boot times. The docs only make a vague claim of "maintaining performance" with no latency figures. The community comments about 1-5 second and 20-50ms boots describe the commenters' own Firecracker setups, not this product, so they cannot be credited.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts
